name: The Mars Colony
description: The first colonists of a new Mars settlement each took a different role and hail from a different world. Work out who's who.
clues: 14 ly, 16 ly, and 17 ly go with Cortex, Drift, and Forge, in some order.

Dasari's distance is higher than both Anders and Cho.
Forge goes with 17 ly if and only if both Dasari goes with Beacon and 17 ly goes with Anders.
Cho, Dasari, and Eklund go with Beacon, Helix, and 16 ly, in some order.
14 ly goes with at least one of Rios, Beacon, or Cortex.
